target: actual final match outcome W; downstream DeltaV/SVI/q frozen until V is selected

history_contract.targets: May retain predeclared bucket-sampled supervised query times.
history_contract.history_source: Use the full as-of observation store, not only supervised bucket rows.
history_contract.current_token: State reconstructed at exact query_ms, event cutoff <=query_ms.
history_contract.past_tokens: K-1 distinct earlier actual frame states preceding the snapshot used by the current token. No duplicate same-frame carry-forward treated as a new observation.
history_contract.causality: All source timestamps <= query_ms; no future interpolation.
history_contract.rnn_padding: Valid observations first (left aligned); padding at tail; pack lengths denote valid prefix.
history_contract.tcn_padding: Keep chronological validity explicitly; gather last valid index and trim convolution tail to preserve time alignment.
history_contract.mask: Boolean; separate from source missingness; zeros reset after numerical scaling.
history_contract.relative_time: (history_timestamp-query_ms)/60000; update consistently at all application times.
history_contract.categories: One frozen TRAIN vocabulary plus UNK; store ten static champion IDs once.

logistic.weights: mean-one normalized; preserve this scale in all fits

lgbm.categorical_encoding: native TRAIN category mapping, dtype and booster features asserted
lgbm.early_stop: TRAIN inner match split, time-balanced Brier

mlp.grid_note: Select a predeclared bounded subset, do not implicitly launch the full product.

history_gru.input_shape: B,K,352 plus static B,10 categorical and B,K mask

team_set_optional.profile: core 267; lossy representation comparison, not a proven improvement

selection.V_CAL: calibration only after final candidate refit
selection.V_SELECT: four-band equal-weight Brier, same-weight logloss tie-break
selection.TEST: report after freeze; all runs remain exploratory due prior exposure
selection.quality_gate: development-only as-of current-state/continuity checks; no preference merely for matching old V labels
